reviews.author: Roger Dalton
reviews.text: Doug did an outstanding job on my property by installing new timbers around flower beds, trimming the shrubbery, cutting & clearing the yard of straw & debris, removing old items in my backyard, trimming tree limbs, & even cleared straw off my roof. Doug also recommended others for jobs that I needed. Not only did Doug provide great service but also was very trustworthy by offering ways to save money. Highly recommend Doug and his team!

reviews.author: Heidi Barker
reviews.text: Doug has taken care of grinding several tree stumps in our front and back yard. He always does a phenomenal job. We highly recommend him if you need your tree stumps taken care of. Doug is dependable and trustworthy.

reviews.author: Crystal Cullom
reviews.text: HIGHLY recommend!!!! Doug has been providing lawn care services for me for the past five years. I’ve also randomly requested that he trim and remove brush from the yard and even called him to clear my driveway during the last snow! He always comes in a timely manner and performs professional work!

reviews.author: Gary Gibson
reviews.text: I'm very pleased with Doug's lawn care. He does excellent and detailed work. You can trust him to take care of your needs. Thanks Doug!

reviews.author: Victoria Quigley
reviews.text: Doug has been providing lawn care for us in the spring and fall for more than 6 years. When Doug does our lawn he finishes with the blower and the sidewalk and driveway are spotless! Today he powerwashed our house and detached garage, second year he has done this for us. He did an outstanding job!! We highly recommend you give him a try for your lawn and outside maintenance.

reviews.author: Ann Keisling
reviews.text: My husband and I recently purchased a new home in which some trees needed to be removed. Doug listened to what we wanted done and worked us into his schedule. The work he did really made a big difference and we are very happy with the results. We would gladly recommend this company to anyone that asks for lawn care.

reviews.author: Connie Nelson
reviews.text: Doug and his crew are very knowledgeable, friendly and professional. Price is comparable and they pay attention to detail. Thanks, Doug for always making sure the yard looks amazing every Friday!

reviews.author: Conlan Martin
reviews.text: Rightmyer has been cutting my grass every 2 weeks since April. Their pricing is competitive with other businesses and they always show up when they say they will. My yard looks fantastic. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Rhonda Kennedy
reviews.text: Doug is dependable and does a good job. He is courteous even when he is busy. He cuts, edges, aerates, and reseeds our yard. Always keeps the yard neat and makes sure the gates are closed when he finishes. My husband and I are very pleased.

reviews.author: Rosemary Morriss
reviews.text: My yard is now well maintained on a regular schedule. They are there when they say they will be there. The value is excellent. I have never been more pleased with a regular ongoing service.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Hopson
reviews.text: Responded in a timely fashion to inquiries, came and checked out our property the next day and 2 days after that we had a yard that looked amazing!! Exceeded our expectations for sure and will definitely be using again!

reviews.author: Johnny Rotten
reviews.text: Top notch work and very knowledgeable in lawn care and tree work. They have mowed my lawn and removed stumps from my property. Highly recommend their services

reviews.author: granny b
reviews.text: I highly recommend Doug Rightmyer Lawncare services. He does a great job and is reliable and dependable.
